name: expired-coupon
title: Expired coupon crashes pricing (TypeError)
description: A campaign change makes get_coupon() return None for unknown or expired codes; apply_discount() still indexes the result. The culprit commit changed the crashing line.

commits.author: Rahul Verma <rahul@shop.example>
commits.message:
Support seasonal campaigns: coupon expiry and maximum discount

Coupons now carry a validity date and a discount cap. get_coupon() returns
None for unknown or expired codes so they are no longer silently accepted.

commits.author: Ananya Iyer <ananya@shop.example>
commits.message: Add request duration to access logs

expected.culprit: Support seasonal campaigns: coupon expiry and maximum discount
